calc_sphere_points_fibonacci: generate uniformly distributed weighted points on a unit sphere using the golden ratio Fibonacci spiral algorithm
calc_sphere_points_random: generate random points on a unit sphere using rejection sampling to normalize points within the unit ball
sample_sphere_for_uma: sample points on a sphere for use in the UMA (Universal Machine learning Architecture) model common utilities
compare_sphere_sampling_methods: compare the deterministic Fibonacci spiral sphere sampling against the random rejection sampling approach for point distribution
weight_sphere_points_by_density: compute density-based weights for sphere points using pairwise distance exponentials to normalize point influence
